Transition matrices of an LTA

transitions.Rd

Transition matrices of an LTA

Usage

transitions(object, at = NULL, se = FALSE)

Arguments

object

A fitted LTA (latentmix).

at

For an LTA with covariates: covariate values (one per covariate, in the order of covariates; a list with one vector per wave for time-varying covariates). Without at the matrices of a covariate model are averaged over the sample.

se

With at: also return delta-method standard errors.

Value

A list of transition matrices, one per pair of consecutive waves (all equal for transitions = "stationary"). Entry [j, k] is the probability of class k at the later wave given class j at the earlier one (rows sum to 1); dimnames from and to. With at: a list with initial (class probabilities at wave 1) and trans (the matrices) at those covariate values, plus initial_se and trans_se if se = TRUE.

See also

lta(), classprobs()

Examples

data(substance)
# \donttest{
# transitions between substance-use statuses from grade 8 to 10 and 10 to 12
t3 <- lta(substance, waves = list(alc_1:mj_1, alc_2:mj_2, alc_3:mj_3), K = 3)
#> Starting Julia ...
round(transitions(t3)[[1]], 2)   # grade 8 -> 10; the diagonal is the stability
#>         to
#> from     class1 class2 class3
#>   class1   0.69   0.24   0.07
#>   class2   0.10   0.73   0.17
#>   class3   0.00   0.17   0.83
# }
